content.value: A company produces $\mathsf { P } _ { 1 } , \mathsf { P } _ { 2 }$ and ${ \mathsf { P } } _ { 3 }$ from two raw materials A, B and Labour L. (15) One unit of product $\mathsf { P } _ { \uparrow }$ requires one unit of A, 3 units of B, 2 units of L. A uńit of product $P _ { 2 }$ required 2 units of A and B each, ·and 3 units of L, while one unit of $\mathsf { P } _ { 3 }$ needs 2 units of A, 6 units of B and 4 units of L. The company has a daily availability of 8 units of A, 12 units of B and 12 units of L. The unit contribution margin fcr the product is Rs. 3, 2 and 5 respectively for $\mathsf { P } _ { 1 } , \mathsf { P } _ { 2 }$ and $\mathsf { P } _ { 3 } .$ Formulate the linear programming model.
